mcNarrative: The Monte Carlo analysis ran 60 simulated futures with varying weekly demand, and the results show that the disruption barely moved the average fill rate, which stayed at 89.6% both before and after the shock. The p5 outcome was 86.8% and p95 was 92.6%, meaning that even in a bad week roughly 1 in 7 orders would go unfilled, and in a good week roughly 1 in 12 would be missed—so the range of likely outcomes is narrow and centered around the same baseline level.
headline: A 78% cut to transit losses at the Atacama-to-Chile mining link barely changed the overall fill rate, which remained at 89.6% both with and without the disruption.
story: Across the chain, every stage kept its baseline fill rate unchanged: Extraction in Atacama, Chile stayed at 91.7%, Processing in Sichuan/Qinghai held at 84.9%, Precursor Manufacturing in Guangdong/Hunan remained at 90.3%, and both Assembly stages in Fujian/Guangdong and Pune/Sanand stayed at 77.9% and 77.8% respectively. The OEM stage in Pune/Bengaluru/Rajasthan also held steady at 90.6%, while the Recycling stage in Mumbai/Pune stayed at 0% both times. Because the disruption only cut how much is lost in transit and did not reduce actual production capacity, the fill rates at each node did not shift, and the overall fill rate actually improved slightly from 89.1% to 96.6% during the disruption window.
risk: Running 60 trials revealed that the worst-case 1-in-20 outcome (p5) for fill rate was 86.8%, which would mean that in a single bad week roughly 1 in 7 orders could go unfilled across the entire chain; if that worst case materialized, many customers would face delayed or missing battery supplies despite the disruption being a transit-loss cut rather than a production halt.
regional: All seven Indian regions tracked stayed in the yellow status with fill rates hovering around 89%, and every single one fell below the 95% service level target—meaning each region would miss its target roughly 1 in 6 weeks under normal conditions, and the disruption did not change that reality for any of them.
